slides.texte_overlay:
what i do every sunday so my
week never feels chaotic

i plan three things

i choose the three things that matter most this week and write them on paper. everything else is a bonus, and the week stops feeling like a list i'll never finish.

i reset my space

i spend twenty minutes making my room and desk calm again. walking into a clean, calm space on monday morning feels like the week has already started well.

i learn one new thing

i spend five minutes learning something completely unrelated to work: a myth, a planet, a painting. it reminds me there's more to life than this week's deadlines.
slides.texte_sophia:
i learn one new thing

i spend five minutes on one lesson completely unrelated to work: a myth, a planet, a painting. i do it with the Sophia app, and it reminds me there's more than this week's deadlines.

slides.texte_overlay:
i prep easy food

i cook one big simple dish that covers three lunches. it removes the most annoying daily decision and saves me from bad food when i'm tired and in a rush.

i go to bed early

i go to bed an hour earlier on sunday than usual. starting monday rested changes the whole week, and it costs me nothing but one episode i didn't need.
